svg.title: Hi, I'm Marvin 👋
svg.desc: I'm a secondary school student in Germany interested in physics, mathematics, chemistry, and programming. I'm especially drawn to problems where theoretical predictions, numerical simulations, and experimental measurements can be compared. My main interests are computational physics/chemistry, robotics, and AI.
